definitions.ach: CA.steady(conn): mean of last 500 ticks of min(100, 100 delivered/offered), user-to-user
definitions.change: flag on minus flag off per topology
definitions.jpu: sum(energy)/sum(delivered) per instance; jpu_pooled sums over the instances
definitions.paired: MARL minus XL-DET per topology; wins = MARL better in the good direction of the metric
definitions.rel_less_jpu_pct: 100*(1 - mean J/unit MARL / mean J/unit XL-DET)

metric_code.functions: CBP.run_metrics, CBP.marl_validity, CBP.learned_provenance, CA.paired, CA.t_ci, CA.wilcoxon
